title: RequestRecord
description: One row per request, written to results/<run_id>/requests.parquet. This is the project's central data contract: every percentile, goodput figure, cost number and chart is a query over these rows, so they regenerate with no GPU.

is_warmup.description: warmup rows are stored but excluded from stats

itl_ms.description: FULL per-token gap list, never a mean. Decode stalls caused by preemption are visible only in this distribution; storing a mean destroys the most diagnostic signal in the dataset.

client_queue_ms.description: client-side wait, kept separate from server queue time

meets_slo.description: per configured SLO; drives goodput, which unlike throughput has a knee

item_id.description: dataset row id; REQUIRED to pair arms item-by-item

correct.description: per-item grade. Paired statistics (McNemar, flip rate, paired bootstrap) are impossible from an aggregate score, so this is stored per request and never only summarised.

mean_logprob.description: garbage-output detector in the smoke gate, and input to the KL/JS divergence arm

prefix_group.description: shared-prefix identity, for prefix-cache hit-rate analysis

turn_index.description: multi-turn replay position; hit rate decays after ~turn 3
